name: Metamagic Rod, Snuffing
body:
Price varies: lesser 9,000 gp, standard 32,500 gp, greater 73,000 gp; Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Aura strong (no school)

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that extinguish magical and non-magical sources of light active on the target as though using the Snuffing Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: lesser 4,500 gp, standard 16,250 gp, greater 36,500 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Snuffing Spell
